message:
This is a reminder that the following position term will end in 30 days:

  • Person: {{ frappe.db.get_value("Person", doc.person, "full_name") or doc.person }}
  • Position: {{ frappe.db.get_value("Position Type", doc.type, "position") or doc.type }}
  • Term End: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.end_date, "MMMM d, yyyy") }}

Please plan for renewal or transition before this date.
name: Position Term Ending
subject: Position term ending in 30 days: {{ doc.type }} ({{ doc.person }})
